comments.body: Snapshots updated; security smoke clean. Merged to main.

content.text: Snapshots updated; security smoke clean. Merged to main.

The markdown sanitizer is two major versions behind and strips the new callout block syntax that the editor has emitted since 2025.08. Pasted callouts render as plain paragraphs, and snapshot tests still assert the old stripped output.

Upgrade sanitize-md to 4.6.x, enable the callout extension with allowed types note|warning|tip|danger, and regenerate editor snapshot fixtures for fixtures/callouts/*.md. Confirm script and iframe tags remain stripped under the new defaults.
Done when all editor package snapshots pass, the upgrade note is in the changelog, and a security smoke confirms no new tag allowlist expansion beyond callouts.
